repos_data.description: Pluggable, extensible virtual file system for Go
Feature-rich filesystem mocking for Go tests: comprehensive error injection, latency simulation, write operations, operation statistics, and...

repo_meta_data.description: vfsStream is a stream wrapper for a virtual file system that may be helpful in unit tests to mock the real file system. It can be used with any unit test framework, like PHPUnit or SimpleTest.
